name: Hanabi: Hana Type B
storyline:
Kenji is an aspiring singer, but he’s been feeling down; he can’t seem to come up with melodies or lyrics for his songs, and to make matters worse, his girlfriend Erika has just broken up with him.
Then, as if by fate, a beautiful female android named Hanabi appears in his life.
She isn't just cute; she handles all the housework—laundry, cleaning, dishwashing, cooking, and even acting as an alarm clock—to support Kenji.
"W-what? You can even help me with my bath...?!?"
This is a love story between Kenji, a man who is hopeless at romance, and Hanabi, an android who knows nothing of love.
Will love truly blossom between the two of them?
summary:
An ultra-high-quality interactive VR drama finally arrives on PS VR!
Experience a heart-pounding life of cohabitation between a serious young man and a beautiful female android—presented in 110 minutes of stunning, high-definition VR.
